title: Baby Girl in Pinafore, Taylor Tot Stroller - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet black-and-white candid snapshot capturing a barefoot toddler girl dressed in a white ruffled pinafore dress, seated inside a classic mid-century metal Taylor-Tot stroller and walker. She is outdoors on a grassy backyard lawn next to a small tree with a wooden fence in the sunlit background, while a curved garden hose rests in the foreground. The image embodies post-war American suburban domestic childhood in the 1950s.
